lines.t: I have walked through the fire with nowhere to hide
And You carried me through every night
I have wandered far, then came back to Your arms
Again and again in Your light
One truth remains the same
I find freedom when I call Your name
YahuShua, have Your way in my life
In my heart, in my soul, in my mind
YahuShua, have Your way every time
For Your purpose is greater than mine
I lift up my hands, I bow down at Your feet
Giving You all of me
YahuShua, have Your way in me
Your goodness surrounds me like rivers of peace
Your mercy keeps washing me clean
You see every road that is waiting ahead
And You hold all my days in between
Your faithfulness won’t let go
You are leading me where I need to go
YahuShua, have Your way in my life
In my heart, in my soul, in my mind
YahuShua, have Your way every time
For Your purpose is greater than mine
I lift up my hands, I bow down at Your feet
Giving You all of me
YahuShua, have Your way in me
Let Your Kingdom come
Let Your will be done
YahuShua, You are the One
You are all I need
You are everything
More than enough for me
Let Your Kingdom come
Let Your will be done
YahuShua, You are the One
When I lose my way
You remain the same
Forever I’ll praise Your name
YahuShua, have Your way in my life
In my heart, in my soul, in my mind
YahuShua, have Your way every time
For Your purpose is greater than mine
I lift up my hands, I bow down at Your feet
Giving You all of me
YahuShua, have Your way in me
Oh, YahuShua, have Your way in me
Have Your way
YahuShua, have Your way in me
My life is Yours
YahuShua, have Your way in me
YahuShua, have Your way in me
Have Your way in me
YahuShua, have Your way in me
My life is Yours completely
